user_query: trass gmail with term avask from last month

intent.goal: search trass gmail content for term avask

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.sender_email,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass'
AND u.database_name IN ('trass.gmail', 'gmail')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%avask%' 
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%avask%'
)
AND u.created_time >= date('now', '-1 month')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000
